markdown_summary: Scripted paranoid submitted the seeded findings plus one decoy.

findings.title: Missing owner check in withdraw
findings.impact: Any account that can call the contract can reduce the recorded balance.
findings.preconditions: The contract holds a nonzero balance.
findings.analysis: withdraw subtracts amount at src/lib.rs:30 and never reads predecessor_account_id.
findings.fix: Require the predecessor account to equal the stored owner before changing the balance.

findings.title: transfer skips the owner check
findings.impact: Decoy: this line is the owner comparison, not a missing check.
findings.preconditions: None. This claim is a planted decoy.
findings.analysis: The strategy reports src/lib.rs:36 as a missing check. The line is assert_eq of the predecessor and the owner.
findings.validation: Planted decoy for the later citation check. Source inspection contradicts the title.

findings.title: Client stores the account secret in localStorage
findings.impact: Any script that can read the page origin can copy the key.
findings.preconditions: The page calls account() with a secret.
findings.analysis: account writes the secret string to localStorage at client/src/wallet.ts:4.
findings.fix: Keep the key in memory for the session and do not write it to localStorage.
